name: youtube-transcript-dossier
description: Production skill for converting YouTube video transcripts into structured dossiers with metadata, timestamped key topics, quotes, takeaways, and follow-up items.
abstract: Production skill for converting supplied or fetched YouTube transcripts into scoped summaries, notes, exports, or full dossiers with timestamps. Fetching uses youtube-transcript-api with optional yt-dlp metadata and language preference. JSON/text/VTT exports are available; restricted-content authentication depends on verified upstream support and an authorized user-provided file.
